title: Current Divider: How Two Parallel Resistors Split the Current
topic: Current divider — two resistors in parallel across a current source I_in split the total current as I_1 = I_in · R_2/(R_1+R_2) and I_2 = I_in · R_1/(R_1+R_2); the smaller resistor steals the larger share

beats.narration: A current source pushes I in into two parallel resistors — how does the current split between them?

elements.content: Two parallel resistors — which branch wins the current?

beats.narration: Both resistors sit across the same two nodes, so they share the same voltage V across them.
